tasks_output.raw: A 50-year-old South Asian female, 5'2", 114 lbs, with no allergies or medications, reports depression and chronic pain. She is vegetarian, exercises 5 days/week, and experiences bloating, constipation, and trouble falling asleep. Hormonal concerns include approaching menopause in 2025 and menstrual issues. Family history notes tuberculosis, kidney stones (brother), diabetes, and high blood pressure (mother). Current supplements are Collagen Peptides (20g), D3 (1000 IU), C (500mg), B12 (1000mcg), and Slow Fe Iron (45mg). Flagged biomarkers show high Iron (200.0 mcg/dL), AST:ALT Ratio (2.31), Total Protein (8.1 g/dL), Lp(a) (20.2 mg/dL), HbA1c (5.1%), Triglyceride:HDL Ratio (1.4), VLDL (16.8 mg/dL), LH (19.24 mIU/mL), Aspartate Aminotransferase (51.0 U/L), TSH (3.23 uIU/mL), FSH (31.92 mIU/mL). Low markers include Calcium (8.6 mg/dL), C-peptide (0.94 ng/mL), Bilirubin (0.28 mg/dL), LDL-C:ApoB Ratio (1.17), Vitamin D (21.4 ng/mL), Blood Urea Nitrogen (8.0 mg/dL), and DHEA-S (38.4 mcg/dL). No mold or chemical exposures are reported.
